level_reasons: Break My Fix finding 1: an input that breaks mqtt_exporter.main._normalize_name_in_topic_msg

issue.title: Doesn't support Shelly 3EM format very well

summary.text: The verifier reproduced the bug and found an input that still breaks the fix: _normalize_name_in_topic_msg(topic='shellies/living-room-3em/emeter/0/power', payload='10') returns ('shellies/living-room-3em', {'power': '10'}), dropping the emeter index so the three phases are not told apart for a device name containing hyphens or digits. Look first at how the topic is matched for device names like…

property.name: 3em_phases_differentiated_any_device_name
property.claim: For a Shelly 3EM topic shellies/<device>/emeter/<phase>/<metric>, changing only the phase must yield a different normalized topic, so the phases can be told apart. This should hold for any device id, including real ids such as shellyem3-XXXX.
property.quote: there's no way to either sum, or differentiate the three phases' measurements

findings.relation: the same before the fix, but the failing call runs the fix's line(s) 172, 173, 174, 182, 183: the fix touched this path and left it broken
